== Biography ==
George, son of [[Glasgow-1530|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Brash-171|Margaret Brash]], was born or baptised on 26 October 1804 in Barony, Lanarkshire, Scotland.<ref>"Church of Scotland: Old Parish Registers - Births and Baptisms," database, National Records of Scotland, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] (accessed 19 April 2025), George Glasgow born or baptised on 26 Oct 1804, son of Robert Glasgow & Margaret Bruce, in Barony, Lanarkshire, Scotland; citing Parish Number 622, Ref 40/357.</ref>.
